content.text: I thought that Fedora would use the provided namespace prefix when first encountering a new namespace, as long as it was encountered in an RDF format that declared namespaces.  But I've been testing this with a simple Turtle document, and I'm seeing generated namespace prefixes (ns001, etc.) for all user-defined namespaces.
I'm seeing the same behavior (disregarding user-supplied namespace prefixes) in 4.5.1 and later.  So if this is a Fedora bug, it's been there a while.
, did you happen to test 4.5.0 and before? If so, are you seeing that the described behavior was introduced with 4.5.1?
, I just tested with 4.1.1, 4.2.0, 4.3.0, 4.4.0, and 4.5.0 — all of them use the user-supplied namespace prefixes when a new namespace is used with a prefix in a Turtle document, e.g.:
, would you please create a new ticket for the issue of user-provided namespaces no longer being registered and link it to this ticket? Thanks!

comments.body: I thought that Fedora would use the provided namespace prefix when first encountering a new namespace, as long as it was encountered in an RDF format that declared namespaces. But I've been testing this with a simple Turtle document, and I'm seeing generated namespace prefixes (ns001, etc.) for all user-defined namespaces.
I'm seeing the same behavior (disregarding user-supplied namespace prefixes) in 4.5.1 and later. So if this is a Fedora bug, it's been there a while.
Esmé Cowles, did you happen to test 4.5.0 and before? If so, are you seeing that the described behavior was introduced with 4.5.1?

Andrew Woods, I just tested with 4.1.1, 4.2.0, 4.3.0, 4.4.0, and 4.5.0 — all of them use the user-supplied namespace prefixes when a new namespace is used with a prefix in a Turtle document, e.g.:

<> a example:Thing ; example:name "Bob" .

In a similar fashion to the setup detailed in: https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2188

...this ticket is to address the situation where resource namespaces are lost:

  • After /fcr:restore of the plantpatents dataset, open a tab with the following resource:
    http://localhost:8080/rest/62/44/53/d5/624453d5-e62a-43ff-b934-a04ab36acc75

Then go through the export/import cycle, and open a different tab with that same resource:
http://localhost:8080/rest/62/44/53/d5/624453d5-e62a-43ff-b934-a04ab36acc75

! Notice the difference... namespaces changed!
